actor: ChatGPT source/log triage; not designated Codex planner or OpenCode reviewer

ciObserved.frozenInstall: completed successfully in the fetched log
ciObserved.logAssurance: Connector-decoded job log was read; this record is a selected factual transcription, not an independently downloaded or hashed full original log. Job display labels differed across reads; the numeric IDs and command identify the evidence.
ciObserved.workflowStatusLimit: Workflow was reported queued while jobs had results. Pending/self-hosted and failed artifact work must be reported separately.

possibilitiesToDistinguish: missing runtime dependency in the actual owning package
package-context resolution changed by emitted artifact placement
installed artifact or lock metadata differing from the expected exact published version
diagnosis.noBlindFix: No root devDependency addition, blanket externalization, node_modules edit or error suppression was made.

observations: tsdown.config.ts reads returned inconsistent text/blob identities at the same ref
follow-up reads of some returned blob identifiers failed with 404
several inferred package paths were not resolvable
sourceRetrievalLimit.interpretation: The owning manifests and configuration were not reliably recovered. Do not infer repository corruption, deleted source or the correct fix from these responses. Use local exact Git objects and installed dependency metadata.

notRun: local reproduction of pnpm run build:lib
new artifact tests or Linux build after a fix
independent review of a source candidate
model calls or system sandbox initialization
nextLocal: Follow LOCAL_AGENT_PROMPT.md to reproduce in the exact complete checkout, fix the owning package or build resolution minimally, validate emitted artifacts and actual Linux CI, and return source plus raw execution evidence.
